_comment: Phase 3 ETF static-attribute catalog (docs/industry_cycle_mvp_design.md section 8.1 'ETF 필터': 대표성/거래대금/순자산/보수/레버리지-인버스/산업외노출/상장이력). These fields change slowly (unlike price), so they are hand-curated here rather than fetched live on every run. Where a real free source could supply a value it was fetched via yfinance .info on the date in `source` (see committee.industry_cycle.etf_quality module docstring); fields yfinance could not supply for a given ETF are left `null` (never fabricated) so committee.industry_cycle.etf_quality reports them as an explicit 'unknown_checks' data gap instead of silently passing or failing that filter.
